symptom: my SCD30 CO2 sensor can't be opened. The SparkFun/Adafruit example constructs it with no address and it throws 'no device'.

files.co2.py:
import board, busio
from adafruit_scd30 import SCD30
i2c = busio.I2C(board.SCL, board.SDA)
sensor = SCD30(i2c)
print(sensor.co2)

gold.diagnosis: i2cdetect shows the SCD30 at 0x61 (97). The SCD30 has a fixed address of 0x61; the adafruit_scd30 driver also defaults to 0x61, but a constructor that omits the address and a stale bus lock from a previous run can both hide it. Pass address=0x61 explicitly.
